entries.evidence: IDA sub_8021B3C

entries.name: collision_box_stride
entries.meaning: Bytes per geometry record.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8021B3C

entries.name: collision_box_count
entries.meaning: Geometry records per actor.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8021B3C

entries.name: collision_enabled_flag
entries.meaning: Native actor participates in collision checks.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8021B3C

entries.name: collision_disabled_flag
entries.meaning: Native actor excluded from collision checks.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8021B3C

entries.name: collision_targets_offset
entries.meaning: Native actor group and target mask word.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8021B3C

entries.name: collision_targets_shift
entries.meaning: First target-mask bit after the actor group nibble.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8021B3C; projectile ownership needs native qualification

entries.name: fighter_state_damage
entries.meaning: Native damage-reaction state, including airborne knockdown.
entries.evidence: IDA action dispatcher to sub_8008580

entries.name: fighter_state_guard_ground
entries.meaning: Native ground guard reaction and blockstun.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_800664C and sub_8006E04

entries.name: fighter_state_guard_air
entries.meaning: Native alternate guard reaction state.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_800664C and sub_8006F38

entries.name: fighter_state_attack_ground
entries.meaning: Native ground attack state.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8007A40 writes at 0x08007C74

entries.name: fighter_state_attack_air
entries.meaning: Native airborne attack state.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_800779C writes at 0x080078D8

entries.name: fighter_state_throw
entries.meaning: Native grapple/self-destruct attack state, including animation continuations.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8007A40 and sub_800B750

entries.name: battle_slowdown_offset
entries.meaning: Low nibble skips combat stepping for the current frame.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8002F2C

entries.name: fighter_command_variant_offset
entries.meaning: Accepted native attack command index; preserved across animation continuations.
entries.evidence: IDA sub_8007A40 and sub_800779C write PLAYERDATA+89 when accepting commands.
